LanguageData.PhobosSetOut_BlockedEdge: the edge of the map is in the way
LanguageData.PhobosSetOut_BlockedGround: the ground will not take it
LanguageData.PhobosSetOut_BlockedTree: a tree is in the way
LanguageData.PhobosSetOut_NoRoom: There is no room for {WHAT} beside {VEHICLE}: {REASON}, and the other side is no better. Clear a patch beside it, or move it.
LanguageData.PhobosSetOut_PieceInUse: Someone is working at the {PIECE} of {VEHICLE}. Wait until they finish, or call them away, before packing up.
LanguageData.PhobosSetOut_InspectPowered: Pitched: {WHAT}, plugged in and drawing {WATTS} W.
LanguageData.PhobosSetOut_InspectUnpowered: Pitched: {WHAT}. No power at its power point: what needs power is off. Wire the power point to a grid or a generator.
LanguageData.PhobosSetOut_RecipeNeedsNode: Needs an upgrade fitted to the trailer this stands beside.
LanguageData.PhobosSetOut_ColdBoxWarm: Not running: no power, so its food is at the air's temperature.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_PlainSetUpRefusal: {VEHICLE} is set up, with its tent pitched. Pack it up first.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_PlainGizmoSetUpDesc: A colonist with construction work comes, chocks the wheels, puts the legs down and pitches the tent beside it with everything inside. It needs a clear patch beside it. Nothing can tow it while it is set up.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailer_PlainGizmoPackUpDesc: A colonist comes, strikes the tent and packs everything away so it can be towed again. What is in the tent's cupboards stays in them; anything lying on the floor stays on the ground.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanCooking_Cooked: {CARAVAN}'s cooks made {COUNT} {MEAL}s at the field kitchen tonight.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanCooking_NoCook: {CARAVAN} has a field kitchen, but nobody fit to cook tonight.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanCooking_NoFood: {CARAVAN} has a field kitchen, but no raw food to cook tonight.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanCooking_NoFuel: {CARAVAN} has a field kitchen, but nothing to burn: carry chemfuel or wood, or fill its burners before you leave.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanCooking_NoWater: {CARAVAN} has a field kitchen, but no water for its kettle: fill the kitchen's tank, or bring a water bowser.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanWater_Empty: {CARAVAN}'s water tanks are empty: its people drink from their bottles and whatever the land offers.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanCooking_Simmered: {CARAVAN}'s kettle simmered {COUNT} {MEAL}s on the move tonight.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanCooking_Halted: {CARAVAN} halts for a meal: its cooks made {COUNT} {MEAL}s at the field kitchen. It drives on in {TIME}.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanCooking_NoRider: {CARAVAN}'s kettle stayed cold tonight: everyone fit to cook is driving or crewing a vehicle. Carry a passenger who cooks, or choose meal halts.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanCooking_HaltGizmoDesc: While this caravan drives through the night, stop for {TIME} each night so every cook can work at the whole field kitchen, as at camp. Off: the kettle simmers on the move instead, tended by riders who are not driving or crewing, for {SHARE} of the meals a cook makes at camp.
LanguageData.PhobosCaravanCooking_HaltGizmoStops: This caravan stops for the night, and its cooks work at the field kitchen then.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingCaravanCooki: Field kitchens cook in a caravan

On by default: once a night, while a caravan rests, its cooks turn raw food from its packs into simple meals at a field kitchen it carries, on its own wheels or behind a hitch, up to twenty a cook. Each meal burns half a unit of the kitchen's fuel, or chemfuel and wood from the packs. It nearly doubles how far carried raw food goes. A caravan that drives through the night has no night's rest: its kettle simmers on the move for half the meals, or it halts an hour for a meal where you choose that on the caravan. Off: field kitchens cook only when set up on a map.
LanguageData.PhobosKettleWater_NoPlumbing: No water: each batch needs {LITRES} L. Fill the kitchen's own tank from a water bowser, or set it up beside plumbing with water.
LanguageData.PhobosKettleWater_NotEnough: Not enough water: each batch needs {LITRES} L. Fill the kitchen's tank from a water bowser or plumbing.
